title: Custom Domain Setup
description: Learn how to set up a custom domain for your store, including DNS configuration and SSL certificate setup.
content:
Custom Domain Setup

Use your own custom domain (e.g., www.yourstore.com) instead of the default subdomain to create a professional brand presence.

Prerequisites

Before setting up a custom domain:

  • Ensure your subscription plan includes custom domain support
  • Have access to your domain's DNS settings
  • Own a registered domain name

Step 1: Access Domain Settings

Navigate to Store Settings → Domain to access domain configuration.

Step 2: Enter Your Domain

Enter your custom domain name (e.g., www.yourstore.com or yourstore.com). Choose whether to use www or non-www version.

Step 3: DNS Configuration

Configure your domain's DNS records at your domain registrar:

Option A: CNAME Record (Recommended)

  • Type: CNAME
  • Name: www (or @)
  • Value: Provided by Matjrii
  • TTL: 3600

Option B: A Record

  • Type: A
  • Name: @
  • Value: Matjrii IP address (provided)
  • TTL: 3600

Step 4: SSL Certificate

Matjrii automatically provisions SSL certificates for your custom domain. This may take a few minutes to several hours. Your store will use HTTPS automatically once activated.

Step 5: Domain Verification

Once DNS changes propagate (usually 24-48 hours), Matjrii will verify your domain and activate it. You'll receive a confirmation email when it's ready.

Subdomain vs Custom Domain

Subdomain (Free):

  • Format: yourstore.matjrii.com
  • Included in all plans
  • SSL included
  • No DNS configuration needed

Custom Domain:

  • Format: www.yourstore.com
  • Requires plan with custom domain feature
  • SSL automatically provided
  • Requires DNS configuration
  • More professional appearance

Troubleshooting

If your domain isn't working:

  • Check DNS propagation status using online tools
  • Verify DNS records are correct
  • Ensure TTL is set appropriately
  • Wait 24-48 hours for full propagation
  • Contact support if issues persist

Domain Management

You can manage your domain settings:

  • Update DNS settings
  • Switch between www and non-www
  • Remove custom domain
  • View SSL certificate status

Best Practices

  • Choose a short, memorable domain name
  • Use .com extension when possible
  • Keep domain registration separate from hosting
  • Enable domain privacy protection
  • Set up email forwarding if needed
